full_judgment: 4. On an application by the plaintiff for temporary injunction filed on 15-9-1985, the learned Subordinate Judge passed an order of status quo with notice to the defendants to show cause. The order of status quo was, however, vacated on 18-2-1987 it is alleged, in the absence of the plaintiff. The plaintiff filed another application for temporary injunction but during the pendency of the said application the defendants allegedly dispossessed the plaintiff from the suit land on 8-3-1987. In that situation, the plaintiff filed an application on 28-3-1987 praying for amendment of the plaint seeking, inter alia, a decree for khas possession of the suit land. In that petition for amendment the correct names of defendants Nos. 3 and 4, who are respondents Nos. 1 and 2 herein, were also given. The application for amendment was allowed.
